resources.string: Burns the phone\'s step counter into the stream. The badge is drawn into the frame itself, so viewers see it on any platform — no browser source needed. The number comes from the pedometer sensor: it counts from the last reboot until you reset it.
This phone has no pedometer sensor — nothing to count.
Physical activity access is needed to read the step counter.
Drag the badge across the preview to move it.
Tap again to start the counter from zero.
